target_customer: Individuals first, now also businesses, funds, advisors and families that want Bitcoin self-custody without hardware wallet complexity
problem: Exchanges are risky custodians and hardware wallets are hard to use, so many people either take counterparty risk or avoid self-custody.
business_model: Self-custody wallet and multisig vault software with services such as direct purchases and lending partnerships; pricing not found

founders.name: Vikas Choudhary
previous_startups: Porter, trucking marketplace backed by Sequoia Capital and Tiger Global

founders.name: Smeet Bhatt
prior_employers: Prodigal (YC S18), marketing and go-to-market lead
education: IIT Bombay, Civil Engineering and Physics

founders.name: Sriram Bhargav Karnati
founders.background_notes: Employers per Bitcoin Magazine, July 2024. YC page says he is a former co-founder of Theya now working on AI at Fireworks AI, so he has left.

technical_complexity.rationale: Secure multisig key management on phones, with recovery and hardware wallet support, is security critical and unforgiving of mistakes.

defensibility.rationale: Open multisig standards make wallets interchangeable and funds can be moved, but custody trust and setup effort create some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Theya moved toward business custody in 2025 to 2026.

market_need_then: Bitcoin Magazine (July 2024) and the YC page frame exchange risk and hardware wallet difficulty as the pain; the 2022 exchange failures are context but no dated spend data was found for the batch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Simplicity first: the world's simplest Bitcoin self-custody; later institutional custody infrastructure.

branding.brand_signature: The world's simplest Bitcoin self-custody tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Bitcoin Magazine and NoBSBitcoin; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Niche crypto press coverage but no evidence of brand-led growth, and the name is easy to mistype (Teya, Thea).

pivots.to: Bitcoin custody infrastructure for businesses, advisors and individuals
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page and the company site now lead with Theya for Business, so the date is approximate.

outcome_analysis: Theya is an active self-custody company that began as a consumer mobile multisig app and now sells vaults to businesses, with the site claiming thousands of customers. One of three founders appears to have left. Funding is only visible through aggregators at roughly 500 thousand dollars, so scale and traction cannot be judged and no clear success or failure factors are supported.
notes: Funding is aggregator only (VCBacked, Caplight, Dealroom, CB Insights): about $500K seed in April 2023 with Y Combinator and others; a $1.5M figure on a low quality site is unverified. Not recorded as a round. Bitcoin Magazine article gives no funding amount. Competitor search found no dated 2023 sources (a low authority aggregator names Nunchuk); list left empty. The pivot date is approximate and inferred from current site language.
